fact: Decree-Law 45/2026 of 8 October 2026 gives the Ministry of State Reform, Local Power and Decentralisation a Systems, ICT Service that ensures the operation, maintenance and support of the ministry's internal systems and equipment.
title: Boletim Oficial n.º 109, I Série de 08-10-2026 (Decreto-Lei n.º 45/2026)
publisher: Boletim Oficial da República de Cabo Verde
